{{Current events|year=2022|month=12|day=7|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] [[shell (projectile)|shell]] [[Kurakhove]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], killing ten civilians and injuring five others. [https://kyivindependent.com/news-feed/update-10-killed-in-russias-attack-on-kurakhove-in-donetsk-oblast (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://news.yahoo.com/eight-civilians-killed-five-injured-163400215.html (''The New Voice of Ukraine'' via ''Yahoo! News'')]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Rojava conflict]]
***[[Turkey]] gives the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] an [[ultimatum]] to withdraw its fighters from [[Manbij]], [[Tell Rifaat]], and [[Kobanî]] within two weeks or face military action. A Turkish official says that [[Russia]] and the [[United States]] have been informed of the deadline. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/7/turkey-sets-two-week-deadline-for-sdf-withdrawal-in-syria-source (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
***At least 12 people, including 10 [[Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland]] members, are killed and several others are injured after an attack by suspected [[jihadists]] in [[Boala Department]], [[Namentenga Province]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/africa/suspected-militants-target-local-volunteers-supporting-burkina-faso-army-63350 (AFP via TRT World)]
*[[Astana Anyar bombing]]
**One person is killed and 11 others are injured by a [[suicide bomber]] in Astana Anyar District, [[Bandung]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-6447191/polri-soal-ledakan-di-polsek-astana-anyar-bom-bunuh-diri (Detik)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Coal mining in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities]] approves the first new [[Coal mining|coal mine]] in the [[United Kingdom]] in 30 years at the [[Woodhouse Colliery]] in [[Cumbria]], [[England]]. The mine is expected to remain operational for up to 50 years. It will create 500 direct and 1,500 indirect jobs in the region, and will take two years to build at a cost estimated at around [[£]]165 million ($201 million). [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/britain-approves-first-new-coal-mine-decades-2022-12-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/12/07/britain-coal-mine/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*The [[Central Bank of Nigeria]] says it will limit individual cash withdrawals to 100,000 [[Nigerian naira]] (225 USD) per week to reduce [[counterfeit|counterfeiting]] and to discourage ransom payments to kidnappers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/7/nigeria-to-limit-cash-withdrawals-to-225-a-week (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Sheffield gas supply outage]]
**[[Sheffield City Council]] have declared a major incident as the natural gas network outage affecting thousands of properties in [[Sheffield]], [[England]] enters its sixth day. Many residents still have no heating in their homes and temperatures are forecast to drop below 0°C in the coming days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-south-yorkshire-63882524 (BBC News)]
*[[Montcada i Reixac rail crash]]
**At least 155 people are injured in a [[train collision]] in [[Barcelona]], [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-trains-collide-spains-catalonia-region-several-injured-emergency-services-2022-12-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Afghanistan]]
**In [[Farah Province]], the [[Taliban]] carries out its first [[public execution]] since [[Fall of Kabul (2021)|taking power]] last year. The executed man was convicted of fatally stabbing another man in 2017, and was executed by the victim's father, according to government spokesman [[Zabiullah Mujahid]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/07/taliban-carry-out-first-public-execution-since-taking-over-afghanistan-last-year (Reuters via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Capital punishment in Belarus]]
**[[Belarus]]ian lawmakers approve a bill which punishes [[high treason]] among officials and military personnel with the [[death penalty]]. The bill also includes prosecution for "spreading false information discrediting the [[Armed Forces of Belarus]]". [https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-approves-death-penalty-high-treason/32165875.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2022 Germany coup d'état plot]]
**[[German police]] arrest 25 members of the [[Reichsbürger movement]] who are accused of planning a [[coup d'état]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-arrest-25-suspects-over-plot-to-overthrow-state/a-64011136 (DW)]
*[[Crime in Jamaica]]
**[[Prime Minister of Jamaica|Jamaican prime minister]] [[Andrew Holness]] declares a [[Jamaica|nationwide]] [[state of emergency]] due to an increase in crime rates in the country. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/07/americas/jamaica-state-of-emergency-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[La Línea corruption case]]
**Former [[President of Guatemala]] [[Otto Pérez Molina]] and his [[Vice President of Guatemala|vice president]], [[Roxana Baldetti]], are sentenced to 16-year prison terms for their involvement. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/guatemala-court-convicts-ex-president-perez-ex-vp-graft-case-2022-12-07/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Jemaah Islamiyah]] member [[Umar Patek]], who was convicted for his role in the [[2002 Bali bombings]], is released on [[parole]] after an [[Judiciary of Indonesia|Indonesian court]] reduced his 20-year prison sentence. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2455239/bali-bombmaker-released-on-parole-from-indonesian-prison-official (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]
*[[Janusz Waluś]], the convicted [[Assassination of Chris Hani|assassin]] of [[South Africa]]n anti-[[apartheid]] politician [[Chris Hani]], is released on parole. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221207-killer-of-s-african-anti-apartheid-hero-hani-freed-on-parole-1 (AFP via RFI)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Peruvian self-coup d'état attempt]]
**[[Peruvian President|President]] [[Pedro Castillo]] announces the dissolution of [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|Congress]], the imposition of a [[curfew]], the creation of an "emergency" government, and early parliamentary elections hours before facing his third impeachment vote. The impeachment is successful and Castillo is later arrested after leaving the [[Government Palace, Peru|Government Palace]] in [[Lima]]. [[Vice President of Peru|First Vice President]] [[Dina Boluarte]] is sworn in as [[President of Peru|President of the Republic]] after Castillo's arrest. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-president-says-will-dissolve-congress-calls-elections-2022-12-07/ (Reuters)] [https://larepublica.pe/politica/pedro-castillo/2022/12/07/pedro-castillo-esta-detenido-en-la-region-policial-de-lima-tras-salir-de-palacio-de-gobierno/ (''La República'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2022/12/7/live-news-perus-congress-votes-to-remove-president-castillo (Al Jazeera)]
